nodes.label: Hybrid Cleaning Strategy (Daily Dry + Periodic Wet Deep Clean)
nodes.source_file: so let's assume there's a way to provide water so....txt
nodes.rationale: Global gold standard for desert solar: dry robots handle ~95% of dust daily at near-zero marginal cost; monthly/quarterly wet cleans dissolve cemented mud and bird droppings, resetting efficiency to 100%; even with free water nearby operators would keep the robots.

nodes.label: Cemented Soiling (Dew + Dust Mud Baked onto Panels)
nodes.source_file: so let's assume there's a way to provide water so....txt
nodes.rationale: Dry robots cannot remove cemented soiling and plateau at 95-98% restoration; water dissolves it and restores ~100%.
